neighborhoods.name: CREEKS EDGE TOWNHOUSE APTS (RH, DUPLEXES, AND QUADS)
CASHWELL FARM PH 5, ET AL/ TYSON CORNER/ ASBY
SO HAMPTON AT TIMBERLKE SEC II

Cumberland.method: Median recorded sale price per heated square foot, by the county assessor's own neighbourhood, by year. Medians, not averages, so one unusual sale cannot move a cell. Per square foot, not per house, so a change in what sizes sold is not mistaken for appreciation. Neighbourhoods with fewer than 8 sales in either end year are marked thin and left out of the county figures.
Cumberland.notWhat: This is not a repeat-sales index: it compares different houses in the same neighbourhood, not the same house twice, so it does not control for condition or renovation. It is not an appraisal and reaches no conclusion about any particular property.
Cumberland.authority: Sale prices are as recorded. Where the excise stamp is published it is the consideration the parties swore to, at $1 per $500 under N.C. Gen. Stat. 105-228.30.
